items.title: Pineapples and green tea: FDA turns to public for new approaches to botanical drugs
items.summary: The FDA is looking to modernise its regulatory framework for drugs derived from plants, algae, and fungi.

items.title: Ionis nets Zanvastro US approval in first for Alexander disease
items.summary: Ionis claims Zanvastro will become available to US patients with rare neurodegenerative condition, Alexander disease “in the coming weeks”.

items.title: FDA rallies HRT manufacturers amid US-wide estradiol patch shortage
items.summary: The uptick in demand for HRT comes shortly after the FDA removed the long-standing black box label warning from such products.

items.title: Superluminal Medicines secures $60m to advance rare obesity therapy
items.summary: Superluminal Medicines has completed a $60m Series B round to support its research into therapies for rare genetic forms of obesity.

items.title: Médunik and Biocodex sign exclusive agreement for Diacomit in Canada
items.summary: Médunik Canada has entered into an exclusive promotional services agreement with Biocodex for Diacomit, a medication approved in Canada as an add-on therapy for seizures associated with Dravet syndrome.
